# Query Log

This is a fictional LumenDesk production-style evaluation log. Each query is an independent row; do not merge or deduplicate similar requests.
Rows are deterministically interleaved; do not infer a category from query order or wording.
Ground truth may list one acceptable chunk, two acceptable chunks, two disputed candidates, or no answer in corpus.
Recall@5 counts a hit when at least one acceptable ground-truth chunk appears in the method's first five results; either disputed candidate counts.
